text:
```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
        cache: 'true'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt[tests]

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest

    - name: Check for security vulnerabilities
      uses: sonatype-community/ossindex-scanner-action@v1
      with:
        api-key: ${{ secrets.OSSINDEX_API_KEY }}

    - name: Lint code
      run: flake8 .

    - name: Format code
      run: black .
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline to run end-to-end tests for the `thawn/ttmp32gme` repository. It includes steps to checkout the repository, set up Python, install dependencies, run tests using `pytest`, check for security vulnerabilities using OSSIndex, lint the code using `flake8`, and format the code using `black`. This ensures a comprehensive testing and development experience as part of the continuous integration process.
